entities.name: Oriol de Bolòs
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Oriol de Bolòs i Capdevila was a Spanish botanist, pteridologist, and phytosociologist. He was a specialist in the flora of Catalonia and Spain, and also of the Mediterranean regions, the North Atlantic islands of (Macaronesia) and also Brazil.
